rate_limits: 120 requests per minute generally; lower endpoint-specific limits may apply
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor right. Official docs (https://developers.printful.com/docs/) state "Printful API has a general rate limit of 120 API calls per minute" and that resource-intensive endpoints (e.g. mockup generator) have lower limits; v2 docs also note 120/60s default. example.request: auditor right. Store Information API documents GET /stores (getStores) and GET /stores/{id}, not /store; response is a result array with paging. Evidence: https://developers.printful.com/docs/ (#tag/Store-Information-API/operation/getStores).
